voice.name: ash
voice.instructions: An upbeat, confident product-launch narrator. Brisk and energetic but clear, crisp consonants, short punchy delivery, a smile in the voice. Never shouty.

shots.name: hook
shots.vo: Forty tabs. Six PDFs. And you still don't get the paper? Meet Koios.

shots.name: find
shots.caption: Every index. *One* search.
shots.vo: Search arXiv, Scholar, Semantic Scholar and more, all at once, in one clean list.

shots.name: copies
shots.caption: Every copy. *Every* author.
shots.vo: Every place a paper lives, and every paper a person wrote.

shots.name: desk
shots.caption: Back to the *exact* line.
shots.vo: Your library remembers the exact line you stopped at.

shots.name: read
shots.caption: PDF. Reflow. *Book*.
shots.vo: Read it as typeset, reflowed, or as a book.

shots.name: lookup
shots.caption: Right-click to *understand*.
shots.vo: Right-click any term: what it means, and where the idea came from.

shots.name: notes
shots.caption: Keep it all, in *your notes*.
shots.vo: Highlights, comments and figures, kept in your notes: by section, or on a board.

shots.name: ask
shots.caption: Answers that *point* at the paper.
shots.vo: Ask AI sees your screen, and every answer points to the exact passage.

shots.name: models
shots.caption: Claude. DeepSeek. Gemini. *The web*.
shots.vo: Claude, DeepSeek or Gemini, with web search when you want it.

shots.name: papers
shots.caption: Papers it names, *saved* in a click.
shots.vo: Papers it mentions? Saved to your library in one click.

shots.name: explain
shots.caption: Press *E*. Get it.
shots.vo: Press E, and the whole paper is explained, maths and all.

shots.name: colab
shots.caption: From paper to *running code*.
shots.vo: Then it plans the build, writes a notebook, and runs it on a GPU.

shots.name: agents
shots.caption: An agent that's *read the paper*.
shots.vo: Turn the paper into a project, and let Claude Code, Codex or Koios AI build it, tests and all.

shots.name: vscode
shots.caption: Right in *VS Code*.
shots.vo: In the page, or in VS Code.

shots.name: sims
shots.caption: *31* simulators. Watch it learn.
shots.vo: Thirty-one simulators. Watch your agent learn, live.

shots.name: filed
shots.caption: Every run, *filed* for you.
shots.vo: And every run is filed in your logbook, automatically.

shots.name: anywhere
shots.caption: Code here. Compute there. *You, anywhere.*
shots.vo: Code on your laptop. Compute on a GPU. Data in Drive. And you, anywhere.

shots.name: run
shots.caption: One command. *A100* power.
shots.vo: One command sends it to the GPU.

shots.name: mount
shots.caption: Your folder, *live* on the GPU.
shots.vo: Or mount your folder on the GPU, live.

shots.name: together
shots.caption: Write together. *Cite* as you go.
shots.vo: Work with your team, write in LaTeX, and cite as you go.

shots.name: end
shots.vo: Koios. Read the paper. Then run it.
